New filter mechanics! Now you also need to take care of the level of water filtration in aquariums to keep the fish happy. 3 new filters have been added. notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
We are back with another batch of bug fixes to make the game even better and for you to continue playing without any problems!

Amendments:

- Fixed a bug that caused fish that were in good conditions in tanks in the oceanarium and museum to become much smaller than they should be. We were surprised that we discovered this bug only now and no one had reported it before. From now on, specimens in these locations can be much larger!!! Definitely come in and see how big fish you can now have in your tanks in these levels!!!

- The number of plants and decorations in large tanks has been adapted to their size. Thanks to this, now you can put much more things in the largest tank in the oceanarium and in the tanks in the museum and the requirements of the fish will still be met! You can finally decorate your tanks even more.

- Fixed the bug that the sea explorer quest disappeared from the basement location when the player moved to the exhibition level, now everything works correctly (For those who encountered this bug, after 6 days in the game the basement quest should appear again so the bug will fix itself)

- Fixed bug in underwater expedition levels. If a player has lost a utility item or the item has sunk into the ground, after reloading this level, these items should be on the table in our base again.

- Improved mechanics of using the hammer, now you can destroy/build much easier. We fixed the situation where sometimes the game did not count hits with the hammer and it just works and feels better :)

- For tasks with rare species from marine researchers, an option has been added when the player fails to complete the task (the fish died or you sold all of them before finishing the quest). You can close such a task and the note about the rare fish will disappear.

- Fixed a bug where purchased fish that did not fit in the inventory and ended up on the table very often could not be picked up

- Fixed a rare bug that blocked the cleaning machine in the museum level, making it unusable and blocking access to change to other locations. Now this no longer happens, and for those who have encountered such an error, the game will fix it itself

- Fixed a bug that happens very rarely, when loading the game, aquarium decorations appeared in the wrong places and in strange sizes and the fish started dying. From now on, this won't happen to anyone

- Fixed a bug that when throwing fish into some tanks, the caustics of the water in the aquarium turned off for a moment, now it’s correct.

- In the underwater expedition (Greek), fish trapped in nets appear on the radar as red dots, just like in the Egyptian expedition.

- Fixed a bug where it was very difficult to pick up the aquarium or enter the edit mode at one table in the basement (it was the one right next to the door), now everything works correctly

- Hammer hit particles when hit with a hammer only appear when the item can actually be destroyed

- Fixed a bug that sometimes blocked the money that the player received in the UI and remained suspended in the air when it should have disappeared

- Improved game loading on underwater levels where rewards received for cleaning the seabed were not always saved

- Fixed that goldfish became invisible when player were inside an aquarium

- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to enter the letter Q in the names of aquariums because the inspection panel closed then, now it is possible

- Fixed a bug where players playing on monitors with a width of 1280 pixels or less could not completely clean the walls of the aquariums from algae

- Fixed a bug where the player pressed the pause button while holding a sponge and standing in front of a dirty aquarium, which when resuming the game moved him to clean the wall, bugging the game by creating a strange camera shake effect

- Fixed the box in the cave in the aquarium that was stuck in the wall and couldn't be pulled out

- We have updated the game icon on the desktop to a newer and nicer one

- Many minor game and UI fixes

notes.title: Island Adventure Major Update🏝️
notes.content:
Hello Aquarist fans! 🐟

Today we have a major update for you! We hope you'll find it useful and interesting ːsteamhappyː
Here it is!

[previewyoutube=cXMBMKAeg-I;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/2ec51dc675264dc7455a7294b877b510f43af1ce.png

New products:


a completely new task has been added to the game for a client who asks us to help him prepare aquariums and more on his desert island. 😱🌅 Will you be able to prepare everything without access to the store and based on things you can find on the island? Of course, there are new fish and decorations to discover! 🐬🌊
algae-eating fish have been added to the game. A new icon with the algae-eater attribute appears next to the appropriate fish. Such fish slowly eat algae from aquariums, so you won't have to do it manually and your aquarium will be well-kept. 😜🍃
a new aquarium has been added to the game which the player can buy and use. A tall aquarium allows you to introduce even more fish and arrange the decorations better! 🐠🐡
if a certain number of aquarium cleaning tasks are completed, customers will receive a reward in the form of 3 new fish that will make your freshwater aquariums even more diverse!🤩
two fish models have been replaced with much nicer versions: Amphiprion ocellaris and Zanclus cornutus 👀
one additional fish available from the very beginning of the game has been added a new variation of the Balistoides conspicillum fish 
a diving mask effect has been added when going underwater in underwater levels🌊 selling/removing decorations no longer causes an "explosion" 😱💥 near the decoration, this means that other items placed near the removed decoration will not be moved/overturned, which makes building aquariums easier

Of course, first you have to restore the place to its old splendor and beauty, and surely visitors will be happy to come to visit the new place. notes.title: Go with the glow! - new update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/bd13088bf14b91a0ff94953780c7e86fe0a8cb0e.png

Welcome, our underwater Friends! 🐠

A list of changes:


 a new amazing part has been added to the aquarium! A beautiful cave with built-in aquariums, customizable lighting, and exotic species to be prepared for visitors. We can expect: shrimps, jellyfish, glo fish (glows in the dark), electric catfish (can kill with electricity) and Arapaima (giant freshwater fish)

 the water pH system hit the game. Now the player will have to carefully choose what to do regarding it, extreme neglect of this factor can even kill the fish!

 the game already supports most ultrawide resolutions: 5120x1440, 3840x1600, 3440x1440, 2560x1080 and 4k resolution 3840x2160

 an automatic feeder has been added to the game! will help you to feed the fish when your aquariums become really large, but remember that it also has a limited capacity, after which you need to refill it

 fixed a bug that it was possible to do the task at the client's level over and over again at the exhibition

 an additional internal saves backup system has been added to the game. If your subscription broke (the game started from the beginning or deleted your aquariums), contact us immediately via e-mail: piotr.pochopien.krk@gmail.com and we will save your records and you will be able to return to the game

 you can no longer get stuck accidentally selling an aquarium, or opening a shop to visitors with an item in your hand

 after hovering over the icon, we will get hints what exactly it means, when buying fish, after hovering over the icon, we will see exactly how many plants and decorations it needs to feel good in the aquarium

 fixed a bug that sometimes items were left in our hands and it was impossible to get rid of them

 the hammer can be put back in the item cupboard

 removed strange shadows that appeared on the basement floor

 farmed fish that have reached their maximum sales volume provide a little more money

 repaired disappearing decorative plants in pots when approaching them

 fixed a bug that the fish left in the bags changed their size after loading the game

 fishes that cannot fit into the aquarium in a given level will not appear in the shop for purchase, so as not to make an accidental purchase

 swimming under the large aquarium in the oceanarium is easier

 improved system of plants in the game, after loading the game, the plant resumes its growing process correctly, if it was dying, it continues dying and there is no situation that we will grow giant plants
